high_level_description: The image is a screenshot of an article from CNN US, dated Wednesday morning at 10:10 AM. The article describes a tragic event that occurred at Annunciation Catholic School in Minneapolis. The setting is a church where pre-K through 8th grade students were attending Mass to mark the first week of school. The article begins with the sound of church bells ringing mournfully in the distance as Minneapolis Police Chief Brian O'Hara describes the "unthinkable tragedy" that unfolded. The incident took place just before 8:30 a.m., when students were inside the sanctuary attending Mass.
